name: desktop-1
why: the report counts are the ones AGENTS.md pins (1186 events / 47 passes / 493 resources / 63 findings from 20 detectors), and 1,186 is every id with bound state up to the frame's last event rather than a count of draws

the file-side three fire nowhere: this frame's markers balance, every draw and dispatch sits inside one, and none of them is zero-work -- a label of 0 is the same claim as a label of 21, and it is the one that would have caught a detector that stopped looking
the findings histogram is what turns "63 findings" into "63 findings of these eight kinds": a detector that stopped firing while another fired more would keep the total and lose the fact

the self-A/B compares this bundle with itself, so every one of its nine numbers must be 0 (or `same` = 47 for the pass count): it is the net for the analyser, and the only check here that would catch `replaydiff` itself drifting
